scope: Local implementation of the F11 RS-6 S1 follow-up (RD-MP-30, RD-MP-32, RD-MP-45): the job supplies its final ledger state, the executor validates the closed HOLDOUT ledger and re-derives the baseline final state from the FILLED decisions, and a synthetic bars-v2 fixture lets a real job run end SUCCEEDED. Landed at 3576153 (nine paths). No route, worker, view or runtime root uses it; nothing is installed on any environment.
method: A coder wrote the follow-up. Round 1: an independent tester (Sonnet 5.5) PASS with 16 of 19 mutants killed (survivors equivalent), an Opus 5.5 auditor GO and a Fable 5.1 second opinion with no high finding. Round 2 fix (measurement pins, fill-field typing, non-negative final values, a no-fill test, mismatch names kept when the oracle throws, a header comment for the count-mismatch rule): tester PASS with 13 of 15 mutants killed (survivors equivalent) and Opus GO. Root accepted the round-2 evidence wording in the auditor report.
hashNote: SHA-256 of the line-feed content as Git stores it at 3576153.
result: Local Windows run: mp-executor 32 of 36 pass, with 4 known Windows-only python-runner failures; the full local unit suite was not run (low RAM) and CI runs it. The manifest-v2 measured values (pair 2/1.5: 21 HOLDOUT trades, +0.79672 %, drawdown 0.48159 %) are now reproduced by a pytest. The executor real-job run on bars-v2 with domain atr 2-3 and rr 1-2 selects pair 2/2 with 20 HOLDOUT trades and ends SUCCEEDED with unreplaced metrics and a matched baseline. The two measurements are different runs and are not merged.
limits: bars-v2 is synthetic fixture data, not market data and not research evidence; owner_recommendation_ready stays false and MULTI_PINE_REQUIRES_APP_3B stays in the blockers.
The open-final-position path is covered only by REPLAY perturbation; no real job run ends with an open position.
The local engine hash is a CRLF working-tree value, not a pin.
Four python-runner tests of mp-executor fail on Windows only (known); the full local unit suite was not run, CI runs it.

Executor rules RD-MP-32 and RD-MP-30 are extended by RD-MP-45: a HOLDOUT ledger of any other shape fails the run FAILED EVALUATION_FAILED; a job-versus-trace final-state disagreement is recorded as differences.job_final_state_vs_trace and job_final_state_mismatch (exact, no tolerance, also when the oracle fails) and never changes the run status; a count mismatch HOLDOUT_LEDGER_INCONSISTENT is stored as a baseline error and never changes the status.
The F1 to F30 acceptance with the private source stays open (RD-MP-34).

rootAcceptance.statement: Root reviewed the tester and auditor reports of both rounds and accepted the S1 follow-up as local engineering evidence for F11-01. Acceptance changes no PM-1 credit by itself and deploys nothing.
